name: ADB / BTCL Green Data Center near Chattogram
developer: Asian Development Bank; Bangladesh Telecommunications Company Limited; Posts and Telecommunications Division; PPP Authority
notes: MoU signed for Bangladesh's first green data center, to be located on a BTCL-owned site near Chattogram; renewable-powered colocation for public/private enterprises and BTCL internal storage. Specifications not disclosed.

name: Colocloud Chittagong Data Center
notes: Provider page lists Colocloud Tier-3 data centers across Dhaka, Rangpur, Jessore, and Chittagong, with a Chittagong/Chattogram facility for colocation and dedicated servers; capacity not stated.

name: BDCCL Tier IV National Data Center / Meghna Cloud, Kaliakoir
developer: Bangladesh Data Center Company Limited; Gennext Technologies
notes: Meghna Cloud launched at Bangabandhu/Hi-Tech City, Kaliakoir, Gazipur, hosted in the government Tier IV National Data Center. DCD cites 200,000 sq ft and eight 2.5MW generators; Climate Watch reports total data capacity of 4MW.

name: Yotta Dhaka Hyperscale Data Center Park, Kaliakoir
developer: Yotta Data Services; Shamsul Alamin Group
notes: Yotta announced a Tk2000 crore hyperscale park at Hi-Tech City, Kaliakoir/Gazipur with two buildings, 4,800 racks and 28.8MW IT power. Daily Star later reported construction had begun by early August 2023.

name: DataVolt Bangabandhu Hi-Tech City Data Center
notes: Saudi Arabia's DataVolt announced a $100m data center at Bangabandhu Hi-Tech City in Kaliakoir, Gazipur; BHTPA agreed to allot three acres. Facility capacity not disclosed.

name: Summit Group data center near Dhaka
notes: Summit said it plans to enter the data center market, likely near Dhaka where it has gas-fired plants. TBS reported about 350MW of power capacity could be dedicated to data centers, but no specific IT load or site was finalized.

name: DhakaColo Mohakhali Data Center
notes: Provider and data-center directory pages list a carrier-neutral Tier III-standard DhakaColo facility at Khawaja Tower, Mohakhali, Dhaka with 2N redundancy; capacity not stated.

name: BDCOLO Mohakhali Data Centers
notes: BDCOLO provider page states 3 active Bangladesh data centers, carrier-neutral Tier III infrastructure with 2N redundancy, and lists contact location in Mohakhali, Dhaka; individual site capacities not stated.

name: Colocloud Dhaka Data Center
notes: Provider page lists Colocloud as a Tier-3 data center platform across four Bangladesh locations and gives Dhaka as one facility; page states 4,500 sq ft total data-center area and four locations, but no per-site capacity.

name: Axentec Cypher Data Center, Jashore
notes: Axentec launched the Tier IV-standard 'Cypher' prefabricated data center at Sheikh Hasina Software Technology Park in Jashore, spanning 16,500 sq ft. IT capacity not disclosed.

name: DhakaColo Jessore Data Center
notes: Commercial directories/provider pages list a Tier III-standard DhakaColo Jessore facility at 44 M K Road, Jashore with 2N redundancy; capacity not stated.

name: Colocloud Jessore Data Center
notes: Provider page lists a Jessore data center as part of Colocloud's Tier-3 Bangladesh colocation footprint; capacity not stated.

name: Colocloud Rangpur Data Center
notes: Provider page lists a Rangpur data center as part of Colocloud's Tier-3 Bangladesh colocation footprint; capacity not stated.

name: Grameenphone Super Core Data Center, Sylhet
notes: Grameenphone launched its first Super Core Data Center in Sylhet on 2024-01-30 after construction began in January 2023; described as Tier III standard with 4MW IT capacity.
